answer_1.quote: In NLP, VAEs have been developed for word representation, morphological analysis, syntactic and semantic parsing, document modelling, summarisation, machine translation, language and vision, dialogue modelling, speech modelling, and, of course, language modelling.

answer_2.quote: Our evaluation concentrates on intrinsic metrics: negative log-likelihood (NLL), perplexity per token (PPL), rate (R), distortion (D), the number of active units (AU; ) and gap in the accuracy of next word prediction (given gold prefixes) when decoding from a posterior sample versus decoding from a prior sample (Acc gap).
